title: US VP Vance Arrives in Switzerland to Open Iran Nuclear Talks
detail: US Vice President JD Vance arrived in Switzerland to launch direct talks with Iran on its nuclear programme, marking a significant diplomatic escalation following the recent US-Iran peace deal. The Switzerland meeting signals a new phase in nuclear negotiations as both sides seek to formalize arrangements under international oversight.

media.caption: US VP Vance arrives in Switzerland for Iran nuclear programme talks

title: Khamenei's MOU Stance Stirs Internal Debate as Iran-US Delegations Meet in Switzerland
detail: Supreme Leader Khamenei's position on a potential Memorandum of Understanding with the United States is generating significant internal Iranian debate as negotiating delegations from both countries meet in Switzerland. Hardliners and pragmatists within the Iranian establishment are divided on how far to commit to a written framework, with some fearing a formal MOU would bind Iran to intrusive verification measures while others see it as a vehicle for durable sanctions relief.

media.caption: Khamenei's MOU stance divides Iranian hardliners and pragmatists ahead of Switzerland talks
